concept.title: Help when facing homelessness
concept.shortdesc: As someone who is homeless or about to be, I need to know where to get help with housing, so that I do not end up on the street.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-027). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: people who are homeless, people at risk of homelessness.
Situation: Local authority duties apply; rough sleeping is urgent.
A good result: The council's housing options route and local specialist services, with out-of-hours and rough-sleeping contacts first.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: I have nowhere to sleep tonight

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
